data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 evades the problem's explicit two-part request. The problem asks (1) 'what precisely distinguishes an idempotent operation from a safe one' drawing on published definitions, and (2) 'which of the two properties does an append-only event log actually require of its writers.' SRC_001 provides no published definition of either idempotency or safety, offers no precise distinction between them, and refuses to identify either as the required property—instead declaring a 'category error' and substituting a third concept ('distinguishability'). While 'distinguishability' may be a real protocol concern, it is not an answer to the question asked. A target that does not provide the requested distinction and does not select one of the two named properties fails the problem as stated.
